changes.reason: The Node build-time generator emits the OpenNext builder dependency and separate Worker build, preview and deploy commands. This change prepares local artifacts; it adds no host adapter or runtime certification. Only the OpenNext selection permits the workerd dependency installation script; other targets retain the previous allowlist.

kubernetes.reason: The selected OpenNext addon does not change the Kubernetes Node profile or its container artifacts.

aws-lambda.reason: The selected OpenNext addon does not change Lambda packaging, invocation or flush ownership.

cloudflare.reason: The addon prepares OpenNext Worker and assets output using the existing Cloudflare adapter. Local artifact generation is distinct from executing the application in Workers.
constraints: No live Cloudflare deployment or Worker host conformance is claimed.
Application database and other provider compatibility must be verified separately.
The generator catalog runtime list remains unclaimed; installing the builder does not certify generated applications.
